title: On Vojta's harder implication, height inequalities for admissible pairs, points of bounded degree and Deligne-Mumford stacks
summary: We expand on the concept of \emph{admissible pairs} from \cite{Levin:GCD} and explore its relation with the main Diophantine arithmetic inequalities, with discriminant term and for points of bounded degree, that have been predicted by Vojta \cite{Vojta:1998}. In this context, among other new results, we prove a \emph{harder implication} which is in the spirit of Vojta's approach to the abc Conjecture (from \cite{Vojta:1998}).
